## What to build

Add `is_palindrome(text: str) -> bool` in a new module `src/textkit/palindrome.py`. It ignores case, whitespace and punctuation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `is_palindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama")` is true.
- [ ] `is_palindrome("textkit")` is false.
- [ ] Tests in `tests/test_palindrome.py`.
